remarks:
H117326    
Situated on 3.5 acres, this 3-bedroom, 1-full-bath home combines a peaceful country setting with practical updates and convenient access to Western New York.
Inside, you’ll find a comfortable and functional floor plan featuring first-floor laundry that includes a new dryer, newer flooring, a remodeled full bathroom, and an outstanding kitchen with generous counter space and breakfast-bar seating. The adjoining living area features warm hardwood flooring and plenty of room to relax. A new furnace installed in January 2026 provides an important recent mechanical update, while the roof is approximately 10 years old.
Outside, mature trees and open lawn create plenty of room to enjoy the 3.5-acre rural setting. One of the property's standout features is the detached garage with a 100-amp electrical subpanel and workshop space—ideal for hobbies, projects, equipment or additional storage.
Located in Corfu, New York, this property offers the space and quieter pace of country living while maintaining convenient access toward Buffalo and Rochester, NY.
If you've been searching for a 3-bedroom home with acreage, first-floor laundry, a garage and workshop in Western New York, this one deserves a closer look.
